resources.string: If fingerprint unlock was already enabled, use it to open the app. Changing or disabling the PIN requires the current PIN. There is no reset that keeps access to protected data. Clearing app storage in Android settings removes the PIN and all local records; only an existing backup can restore those records.
The saved PIN cannot be read. Use previously enabled fingerprint unlock or read “Forgot PIN?”. Your records have not been deleted.
Your previous PIN setting is unchanged. Try entering the PIN again.
